Messages.Author: Alan Eisinger
Messages.Body:
This is a deck design of mine, based on the weenie rush concept.
Most of the combat cards do not cost blood, and the rush element
stressed because a 3 cap is less likely to torporate than many.
This deck is built under NCL and GT+. It has been played once,
where it ousted 1 prey (Toreador intercept/vote/gun) before getting
Anvil contested and falling to a Ventrue vote/bleed.

One card at a frequency of 10 does not an OTP make. When most of the
combat is done by 3 and 4 cap vamps, it often takes more than one combat
to torporize an enemy vamp. And with so many minions out (the purpose of
weenie decks) you have a lot of potential actions. Thus, the 10 BRs are
important to make this deck function the way it should. If your last
sentence indicates that you play 1CL, I doubt you will find many that share
your views. (In fact, there was a short thread about 1CL just a few weeks
ago, wasn't there?) 4CL, OTOH ...

gnfnrf
